anatomy.label: Visible label above input; input accessible name derives from label.
anatomy.overlay.surface: Separate popup surface anchored to this input.
anatomy.overlay.scroll.viewport: Separate clipped scroll viewport within the popup.
anatomy.list: Semantic listbox within the scroll content; belongs to Autocomplete.
anatomy.option: One repeated result part per stable key.
anatomy.status: Visible status text below the popup when present, otherwise below the input.

viewSemantics.value: Last explicitly committed result key; absent means no selection, null is not an alias.
viewSemantics.selectedView: Derived closed state with a present value; not an additional independent behavior variable.
viewSemantics.requestIdentity: owner + epoch + seq; accept only current responses.
viewSemantics.repeatedPartIdentity: instance + option key, never row index.

targetScope.openpencil: Editable named component states. No interactive combobox behaviour or ARIA execution claimed.
targetScope.web: Future HTML/TypeScript output; no hand-authored per-component implementation is a master source.
